QuestInfo.name: The Lowdown
QuestInfo.0: You came to #m260000000# in search of your secret vault. You may have to break another #o9001045# to get into this one. The price tag on these advancements is really racking up.
QuestInfo.1: Unlike the vault in #m200000000#, the #o9001045# here is busted wide open. You found a bunch of scummy little #r#o9001046##k critters loitering around inside. It's time to wipe them out!
QuestInfo.2: Your old journals have gotten you through your 3rd Job Advancement. Looking over the masses of wealth in this old vault, you feel a little nostalgic. Has it really been hundreds of years since you were here?

0.0: Something's fishy here. I smell dust. There should never be dust in my vaults! They're air tight!

1.0: This vault brings back so many memories. It feels like only yesterday that I was watching nouveau riche snobs buy themselves positions of power.

yes.0: Nothing but a bunch of well-off wolves, taking whatever they could from people who needed it. I can't believe I used to call it home before I devoted my life to taking people like them down. And now they're all gone...
yes.1: I threw away my old name for them. I became Phantom for them. And now I'm here and she's gone...
